18	ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
19	 
20	  Pursuant to India na Code chapte r 8 -1-26, the Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”)  of 
21	the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission  (“Commission”) investigates excava tion damage 
22	cases and makes findings violations of said chapter. Upon review of those findings, the Indiana 
23	Underground Plant  Protection Advisory Committee (“Advisory Committee”) reviews those 
24	findings and recommends civil penalties in each case.   
25	 
26	Attached to this order are the cases received , with Division findings of violations and 
27	Advisory Committee recommendations, that are ripe for Commission action.   
28	 
29	The Commission hereby UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Division and 
30	APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the attached  pages. 
31	The Office of General Counsel is directed to prepare and send notice to the parties advising them 
32	of the determination. 
33	 
34	Civil penalties approved by the Commission are due within 90 days of the date of this 
35	Order unless payment arrangements are made with the Commission’s Office of General Counsel.   
36	 
37	Trainings approved by the Commission must be completed no later than 90 days from the 
38	date of this Order unless o therwise agreed in writing by the Commission’s O ffice of General 
39	Counsel for good cause shown . Failure to complete the training r esults in the alternative civil 
40	penalty noted in the attached recommendation becoming due.   
41	 
42	IT IS SO ORDERED. 
43	 
44	HUSTON, BENNETT, FREEMAN, VELETA, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR: 
45	 
46	APPROVED: 
47	 
48	I hereby certify that the above is a true 
49	and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
50	 
51

53	Dana Kosco 
54	Secretary of the Commission

STATE OF INDIANA

IN THE MATTER OF AN ORDER 
APPROVING ADVISORY COMMITTEE 
RECOMMENDATIONS PURSUANT TO 
INDIANA CODE CHAPTER 8-1-26.  
     
)

APPROVED: 
 
ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
 
  Pursuant to India na Code chapte r 8 -1-26, the Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”)  of 
the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission  (“Commission”) investigates excava tion damage 
cases and makes findings violations of said chapter. Upon review of those findings, the Indiana 
Underground Plant  Protection Advisory Committee (“Advisory Committee”) reviews those 
findings and recommends civil penalties in each case.   
 
Attached to this order are the cases received , with Division findings of violations and 
Advisory Committee recommendations, that are ripe for Commission action.   
 
The Commission hereby UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Division and 
APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the attached  pages. 
The Office of General Counsel is directed to prepare and send notice to the parties advising them 
of the determination. 
 
Civil penalties approved by the Commission are due within 90 days of the date of this 
Order unless payment arrangements are made with the Commission’s Office of General Counsel.   
 
Trainings approved by the Commission must be completed no later than 90 days from the 
date of this Order unless o therwise agreed in writing by the Commission’s O ffice of General 
Counsel for good cause shown . Failure to complete the training r esults in the alternative civil 
penalty noted in the attached recommendation becoming due.   
 
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
 
HUSTON, BENNETT, FREEMAN, VELETA, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR: 
 
APPROVED: 
 
I hereby certify that the above is a true 
and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
 
 
      
Dana Kosco 
Secretary of the Commission

ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
 
  Pursuant to India na Code chapte r 8 -1-26, the Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”)  of 
the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission  (“Commission”) investigates excava tion damage 
cases and makes findings violations of said chapter. Upon review of those findings, the Indiana 
Underground Plant  Protection Advisory Committee (“Advisory Committee”) reviews those 
findings and recommends civil penalties in each case.   
 
Attached to this order are the cases received , with Division findings of violations and 
Advisory Committee recommendations, that are ripe for Commission action.   
 
The Commission hereby UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Division and 
APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the attached  pages. 
The Office of General Counsel is directed to prepare and send notice to the parties advising them 
of the determination. 
 
Civil penalties approved by the Commission are due within 90 days of the date of this 
Order unless payment arrangements are made with the Commission’s Office of General Counsel.   
 
Trainings approved by the Commission must be completed no later than 90 days from the 
date of this Order unless o therwise agreed in writing by the Commission’s O ffice of General 
Counsel for good cause shown . Failure to complete the training r esults in the alternative civil 
penalty noted in the attached recommendation becoming due.   
 
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
 
HUSTON, BENNETT, FREEMAN, VELETA, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR:

and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
 
 
      
Dana Kosco

**Answers (2023 vs 2024)**

- **(a) Non-utility cases with headline penalty ≥ $5,000:**
  - 2023: 624 of 1,502 = **41.5%**
  - 2024: 688 of 1,421 = **48.4%**
- **(b) Utility-respondent share of all cases:**
  - 2023: 605 of 2,107 = **28.7%**
  - 2024: 476 of 1,897 = **25.1%**

**How I got these**

- I used the 25 order texts for 2023 and 2024, taking each order's date from its filename (MMDDYY). The text files contain no order date, so this is an assumption. The filenames agree with the advisory-meeting dates I checked.
- Total cases per year come from counting "Respondent:" lines: 2,107 in 2023 and 1,897 in 2024. The "civil penalty:" count gives the same totals.
- Utility cases come from matching the respondent names in the question's list, ignoring case.
- Headline penalty is the first "$" amount after "civil penalty:". I checked that no recommendation has a larger amount after a smaller first one. "Violation found; no penalty recommended" and "Warning letter" count as $0.
- Counts were made with multiline regex searches, not a per-case listing. I spot-checked the method on order 080923 (one qualifying case, as expected) and on 011724 (two utility cases ≥ $5,000, as expected). Bash and Python were unavailable, so I could not run a full script.
- I could not open the PDFs to verify the text extraction, because pdftoppm is not installed. A few orders have very few cases (080923 has 3, 121323 has 2, 103123 has 13). I took these as they appear in the text, without checking them against the PDFs.
